items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

At Live Junk Free, we provide fast and reliable e-waste removal for all types of electronic equipment, from home computers and TVs to office servers and commercial equipment. We understand how quickly obsolete electronics can pile up, creating clutter and potential security risks when they’re no longer in use. Our professional service helps you clear out this e-waste safely without any hassle on your part.

The process couldn’t be more straightforward. We begin with a free, no-obligation quote so you know exactly what to expect. Once approved, our certified team handles everything: secure data wiping (when required), safe disconnection of all devices, careful removal from your premises, and guaranteed environmentally-responsible recycling through certified e-waste facilities. We make electronic waste removal so efficient that most residential jobs are completed in under an hour, giving you instant space and peace of mind.

items.q: What types of electronic waste do you remove?
a: We remove all electronics – computers, TVs, phones, printers, servers, gaming consoles, and more. Whether working or broken, we responsibly recycle all devices through certified facilities.

items.q: How do you safely dispose of e-waste?
a: All electronics are processed at certified recycling centers that safely handle hazardous materials and ensure proper data destruction when required.

items.q: How much does e-waste removal cost?
a: Prices start at $125. Get a free exact quote by sending photos of your items – no hidden fees ever.

items.q: What areas do you serve for e-waste removal?
a: We service the entire GTA, including Toronto, Mississauga, Vaughan, and surrounding areas. Call to confirm your location.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day e-waste pickup?
a: Yes! We offer same-day/next-day service when available. Call early for fastest scheduling.
